definitions.explanation: A six-sided polygon. Used in mathematics, and as a description for honeycomb cells, nuts and bolt heads, snowflake patterns, and other six-sided objects.

examples.japanese: {六角形|ろっかくけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
ハチの{巣|す}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六角形|ろっかくけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A beehive is made of hexagons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧{六角形|ろっかくけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内角|ないかく}→内角：28901_naikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和|わ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七百二十度|ななひゃくにじゅうど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The interior angles of a regular hexagon add up to seven hundred twenty degrees.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ (six) + {角|かく} (angle / corner) + {形|けい} (shape). The reading is ろっかくけい — the second consonant doubles via sokuon. Also sometimes pronounced ろっ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦っけ→っけ：10739_kke⟧い in speech, but ろっかくけい is the standard reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧{六角形|ろっかくけい}: regular hexagon (all sides and angles equal)
- {六角形|ろっかくけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧: hexagonal shape
- ハチの{巣|す}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: honeycomb structure (six-sided)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧: triangle
- ⟦{四角形|しかくけい}→四角形：05437_shikakukei⟧: quadrilateral
- {五角形|ごかくけい}: pentagon
- {多角形|たかっけい}: polygon (general)
